scripts.text: seeking the thrills of discovering the unknown.

looking at odd-looking things all day.

scripts.text: He may open your eyes to a whole new world.
scripts.translation: 。他或许能带你见识全新的世界。

scripts.translation: 听说朱诺有个疯狂科学

scripts.text: in Juno, and a group of people are
trying to thwart his dangerous research.

scripts.text: I'd say the statement is biased.

scripts.text: Who knows? I would steer clear of both of them, though, if I were you.
scripts.translation: 危险。谁知道呢？换作是我，会离他们双方都远远的。

scripts.text: Scholars. Where do they draw the line at their research?
scripts.translation: 学者们啊，他们研究起来究竟有没有底线

scripts.text: have no care for the world, and I'm glad for that.
scripts.translation: 漂泊者什么都不在乎，反而自在。

scripts.text: who's rumored to be obsessed with a dangerous experiment.
scripts.translation: 据说沉迷于危险的实验。去查查

the two--no, three people related to Odin Temple.
scripts.translation: 关的两个人——不，是三个人的故事。

scripts.text: I wonder if Hugel still has the signboard
scripts.translation: 不知道毁葛还挂着招募发掘

scripts.text: Would you go check it out?
I want to hear the story behind those excavators when you get back.
scripts.translation: 回来后我想听听那些发掘者背后的故事。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Kesler, chief of the Phantasmagorika Police.
scripts.translation: 幸会。我是凯斯勒，幻象嘉年华警察队的队长。
欢迎来到幻象嘉年华警察队。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Oh, do you want to know about us at the ^4E9867Phantasmagorika Police^000000? Why, thank you. Not many people are interested in what we do.
scripts.translation: 哦，你想了解幻象嘉年华警察队吗？谢谢你关心我们的工作，很少有人对这些感兴趣。 ^4E9867^000000

scripts.text: You may wonder why such a fresh site needs a policing unit. Well, there's a valid reason.
scripts.translation: 你可能会好奇，这种新开发的地方为什么还要成立警队。原因很充分。

scripts.text: Have you heard of the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000?
scripts.translation: 你听说过末日祈祷团吗？ ^F8081E^000000

scripts.text: They're a cult group propagating the end of the world. They vandalize in the name of their god.
scripts.translation: 他们是宣扬世界末日的邪教组织，还打着神的旗号搞破坏。

scripts.text: It's only recent that they appeared in Phantasmagorika, but they've done so much damage already that scholars and mercenaries have organized this policing unit.
scripts.translation: 他们最近才出现在幻象嘉年华，却已经造成不少破坏，所以学者和佣兵一起组建了这支警队。

scripts.text: The ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000 are mainly sighted around the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000. If you encounter them, feel free to teach them a lesson or two.
scripts.translation: 末日祈祷团主要出现在维鲁斯中央广场附近。遇到他们的话，就给他们点教训吧。 ^F8081E^000000^82ABE9^000000

scripts.text: I understand your enthusiasm, but you should focus on your training for now.
scripts.translation: 我理解你的热心，不过眼下还是专心训练吧。

scripts.text: Phantasmagorika is more dangerous than you think.
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华比你想象的危险。

scripts.text: Thank you for offering to help, but we can manage on our own.
scripts.translation: 多谢你愿意帮忙，不过我们还应付得来。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, what did you say?
Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Wow, you're the first person to ever offer help. We're spread thin, dealing with the Doom Prayers and everything else at the same time.
scripts.translation: 哇，你是第一个主动提出帮忙的人。我们人手紧缺，还得同时对付末日祈祷团和其他事务。

scripts.text: I haven't had time to hear about the work-related difficulties trat the members of my unit may be experiencing.
scripts.translation: 我一直忙得抽不开身，还没机会了解队员们工作上遇到的困难。

scripts.text: Could you make a tour around Phantasmagorika and talk to the police officers?
scripts.translation: 你能在幻象嘉年华巡视一圈，和警员们聊聊吗？

scripts.text: Oh, I thought you wanted to help.
scripts.translation: 哦，我还以为你想帮忙呢。

scripts.text: You haven't met with all the members.
Please come back when you have.
You've met with all my members. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你已经见过所有队员了。谢谢。

scripts.text: I'm glad none of them--Salgran, Gerev, Seiden, and Piffs--are having problems.
scripts.translation: 很高兴萨尔格兰、杰列夫、赛登和皮夫斯都没遇到麻烦。

scripts.text: Please take this small token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation: 请收下这份小礼物，聊表谢意。

scripts.text: If you are not busy tomorrow, could you come back and help me again?
scripts.translation: 如果明天有空，能再回来帮我吗？

scripts.text: Oh, is this your first time in Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 哦，你第一次来幻象嘉年华吗？

scripts.text: This site was only recently discovered, and therefore fairly safe. I can't think of anything you should be worried about...
scripts.translation: 这里最近才被发现，目前还算安全。我想暂时没什么可担心的...
等等，我收回刚才的话——确实有一件事。

scripts.text: This ^82ABE9Verus Excavation Site^000000 is safe, but if you're planning to move to the ^82ABE9Verus Central Plaza^000000, then make sure you're prepared for the worst.
scripts.translation: 维鲁斯发掘现场还算安全，但如果你要去维鲁斯中央广场，务必做好最坏的准备。 ^82ABE9^000000^82ABE9^000000

scripts.text: By the way the excavation of this site just has begun, and everything in it must be kept in place until the excavation is over.
scripts.translation: 这里才刚开始发掘，在工程结束前，所有发现的东西都必须保持原样。

scripts.text: But those Doom Payers are making it impossible. Bah! %$#@#$#@
scripts.translation: 可那些末日祈祷团把一切都搅乱了。真是的！%$#@#$#@

scripts.text: I'm going bald, worrying over them so much. I didn't have much hair to begin with.
scripts.translation: 我都快愁秃了，本来头发就不多。

scripts.text: Um, didn't mean to rant about my hair.
scripts.translation: 呃，我不是想抱怨自己的头发。

scripts.text: Just be careful not to break anything that has been discovered in this site.
scripts.translation: 总之，小心别破坏现场发现的任何东西。

scripts.text: Oh, didn't you bring some Doom Tokens a while ago?
scripts.translation: 哦，你之前不是带来过末日代币吗？

scripts.text: I guess you haven't left? You must like being here. So do I. Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation: 看来你还没离开啊？你一定很喜欢这里。我也是，哈哈哈！

scripts.text: What can I get in exchange for Doom
I remember telling you this when you first brought Doom Tokens, but all right, I don't mind telling you again.
scripts.translation: 我记得你第一次带末日代币来时就问过，不过没关系，我可以再说一遍。

scripts.text: Doom Tokens are exchangeable with Packing Envelope that is often found in the excavation site.
scripts.translation: 末日代币可以兑换在发掘现场经常发现的封装信。

scripts.text: Scholars have found out the envelop activates various effects when opened.
scripts.translation: 学者们发现，打开封装信会触发各种效果。

scripts.text: The duration of the effects is short, but it's still better than nothing.
scripts.translation: 效果持续时间不长，不过总比没有好。[警长凯斯勒]哦，末日祈祷团会带着这种末日代币。

scripts.text: You've brought {0} Doom Tokens. I can give you {1} Packing Envelopes.
scripts.translation: 你带来了枚末日代币，我可以给你封封装信。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Thank you, and keep up the good work.
Um, didn't you say you had Doom Tokens?
scripts.translation: 呃，你刚才不是说有末日代币吗？

scripts.text: Oh, the Doom Prayers carry this ^F8081EDoom Token^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，末日祈祷团会带着这种末日代币。 ^F8081E^000000
你是在哪里发现这个的？

scripts.text: Tell him where you found it.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你在哪里找到的。

scripts.text: Thank you so much for helping us to maintain public peace.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢你帮忙维护治安。

scripts.text: You deserve a reward, but I can't think of anything good.
scripts.translation: 你应该得到奖励，可我一时想不到给什么好。

scripts.text: Oh, I've got an idea! Bring me ^F8081EDoom Tokens^000000, and I'll exchange them with ^4E9867Packing Envelope^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，我想到办法了！把末日代币交给我，我就用封装信和你交换。 ^F8081E^000000^4E9867^000000

scripts.text: It's an envelope often discovered in the excavation site.
scripts.translation: 那是发掘现场经常发现的一种信封。

scripts.text: Scholars have found out the envelope activates various effects when opened.
scripts.translation: 学者们发现，打开这种信封会触发各种效果。

scripts.text: Would you like to exchange your Doom Tokens with Packing Envelope now? Or you can do it later.
scripts.translation: 现在要用末日代币兑换封装信吗？也可以之后再换。

scripts.text: Sure, no problem. It's not like Doom Tokens have an expiration date.
scripts.translation: 当然没问题，末日代币又不会过期。

scripts.text: In exchange for your {0} Doom Tokens, I've given you {1} Packing Envelopes.
scripts.translation: 我用你的枚末日代币，换给你封封装信。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Thank you for your continue support in the subjugation of the Doom Prayers.
scripts.translation: 感谢你继续协助讨伐末日祈祷团。

scripts.text: This is the first thing I tell every new visitor: if you see the ^F8081EDoom Prayers^000000, don't hesitate to report to the nearest police station.
scripts.translation: 每位新访客来时，我都会先提醒：看到末日祈祷团，立刻向最近的警察局报告。 ^F8081E^000000

scripts.text: An error has occurred. If it is the same after retrying, please take a screenshot and ask for the operation.
scripts.translation: 发生错误。如果重试后仍然如此，请截图并联系运营人员。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: Is it right? Is there nothing here, are you nothing?
scripts.translation: 是这样吗？这里什么都没有，你也什么都不是？

scripts.text: You're working a different sector at this moment. Come back when you're done there.
scripts.translation: 你现在负责的是别的区域。那边忙完再回来吧。

scripts.text: Are you helping on other things in other areas?...
scripts.translation: 你正在帮其他区域处理事情吗？...

scripts.text: Haven't you reported to the Captain yet? I told you everything's fine in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你还没向队长汇报吗？我说过我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Ch-Chief Kesler! I-I wasn't dozing off!
scripts.translation: 凯、凯斯勒队长！我、我没在打瞌睡！

scripts.text: Whew, you're not the Chief. Who are you?
scripts.translation: 呼，还好不是队长。你是谁？

scripts.text: Your chief in the middle of Phantasmagorika sent me.
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华那边的队长派我来的。

scripts.text: Thank goodness, he didn't come himself. He must be busy, eh? Welcome. Could you help me out with something?
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地，他没亲自来。他肯定很忙吧？欢迎。能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text: You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你肯定很忙。那请转告队长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Thanks! I've been saddled with some tiresome duties, and I could use your help.
scripts.translation: 谢了！我被一堆麻烦差事缠住了，正需要你帮忙。

scripts.text: You know the Doom Prayers are in our midst, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你知道末日祈祷团就在附近活动吧？

scripts.text: They've been leaving illegal promotional leaflets all over the place, and whatever paper they used, it sticks to the ground like gum.
scripts.translation: 他们到处乱贴非法宣传单，纸张还像口香糖一样黏在地上。

scripts.text: I need to get rid of the leaflets before they permanently glue themselves.
scripts.translation: 我得趁那些传单彻底黏牢前把它们清掉。

scripts.text: Could you get rid of them if you see them in the site? They're giving me a headache.
scripts.translation: 你在现场看到传单的话，能帮忙清理吗？看得我头都疼了。

scripts.text: You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你肯定很忙。那请转告队长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Thank you. Come back when you get rid of 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。清理掉10张非法传单后再回来。

scripts.text: Welcome back. Did the Chief send you again?
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来。队长又派你来了？

scripts.text: Great, can you help me again to get rid of those illegal leaflets?
scripts.translation: 太好了，能再帮我清理那些非法传单吗？

scripts.text: Thank you. Come back when you get rid of 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。清理掉10张非法传单后再回来。

scripts.text: You must be busy. All right, then tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你肯定很忙。那请转告队长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Wow, I thought you left a minute ago, and you're already back. Did you get rid of the Illegal Leaflets?
scripts.translation: 哇，我以为你刚走，没想到这么快又回来了。非法传单都清理了吗？

scripts.text: Oh, good job! The Chief never forgets a favor. He might reward you more handsomely depending on his mood.
scripts.translation: 哦，干得好！队长从不忘记别人帮过他。他心情好的话，说不定会给你更丰厚的奖励。

scripts.text: Hmpf, of course no one can be so quick. I asked you to get rid of at least 10 Illegal Leaflets.
scripts.translation: 哼，哪有这么快的。至少得清理10张非法传单。

scripts.text: They're everywhere in Phantasmagorika. You can't not see them.
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华到处都是传单，你不可能看不见。

scripts.text: Do you have some sort of vision problem? There's no way you can miss them.
scripts.translation: 你是不是视力不太好？怎么可能看不到呢？

scripts.text: I want to say no, but I can't force you. Just go tell the Chief that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 我当然想说不行，但也不能逼你。去告诉队长，我这边一切正常吧。

scripts.text: Haven't you reported to the Captain yet? I told you everything's fine in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你还没向队长汇报吗？我说过我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: Ugh, I can feel the stress building up inside... Argh, this place is giving me an ulcer!

scripts.translation: 他痛苦地揪着自己的头发。

scripts.text: I feel much better now. Please tell Chief Kesler that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 现在好多了。请告诉凯斯勒队

He's pulling his hair in agony.
scripts.translation: 他痛苦地揪着自己的头发。

scripts.text: Ugh, I'm having stomach cramps. Come back when you're done with your current assignment.
scripts.translation: 唉，我胃抽筋了。完成手头的任务后再回来吧。

scripts.text: Are you helping in other areas? It's amazing... I just ask for no pressure...
scripts.translation: 你还在其他区域帮忙？真厉害...希望我这边不要有压力就好。

scripts.text: I feel much better now. Please tell Chief Kesler that everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Argh, where's my pen? I had it when I left the station. Did those robots steal it from me?
scripts.translation: 啊，我的笔呢？离开警局时我还拿着。难道被那些机器人偷走了？

scripts.text: Err? I don't remember putting it there.
scripts.translation: 咦？我不记得把它放那儿了。

scripts.text: Oops, sorry. How may I help you?
Your chief in the middle of Phantasmagorika sent me.
scripts.translation: 幻象嘉年华那边的队长派我来的。

scripts.text: Ah, Chief Kesler sent you. If I didn't know him, I'd have thought he was too busy to come see me. I bet I'm busier than him, though.
scripts.translation: 啊，凯斯勒队长派你来的。如果我不认识他，还以为他忙得没空来看我呢。不过我肯定比他更忙。

scripts.text: Sorry I can't be of help.
You're willing to help the Chief, but not me. Why not because I'm not a chief?
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮队长，却不愿帮我？就因为我不是队长吗？

scripts.text: *Snort* Just go tell Chief Kesler everything's quiet in my sector.
scripts.translation: *哼* 去告诉凯斯勒队长，我负责的区域一切安静。

scripts.text: Are you sure? Because I really hate to be disappointed.
scripts.translation: 你确定吗？我可受不了失望。

scripts.text: As you know, the Doom Prayers are among us. Grr, just thinking about them makes me grind me teeth.
scripts.translation: 你也知道末日祈祷团就在附近。呃，光想到他们我就恨得咬牙切齿。

scripts.text: Yesterday I walked over one of their traps and sprained my ankle,
scripts.translation: 昨天我踩到他们的一个陷阱，扭伤了脚踝，

scripts.text: on top of everything else that's happened to me.
scripts.translation: 最近倒霉事真是一桩接一桩。

scripts.text: Sigh, could you disarm their traps?
scripts.translation: 唉，你能帮忙拆掉他们的陷阱吗？

scripts.text: *Snort* I knew it. Just go tell Chief Kesler everything's quiet in my sector.
scripts.translation: *哼* 我就知道。去告诉凯斯勒队长，我负责的区域一切安静。

scripts.text: Thank you. Please disarm 10 traps installed in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。请拆除幻象嘉年华里的10个陷阱。

scripts.text: I appreciate it if you can get rid of those in my vicinity first.
scripts.translation: 如果能先拆掉我附近的陷阱，我会很感激。

scripts.text: Hello again. Did the Chief send you?
scripts.translation: 又见面了。是队长派你来的？

scripts.text: If you're not busy, could you disarm the Doom Prayers' traps scattered across Phantasmagorika?
scripts.translation: 有空的话，能帮忙拆掉散布在幻象嘉年华各处的末日祈祷团陷阱吗？

scripts.text: Thank you. Please disarm 10 traps installed in Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。请拆除幻象嘉年华里的10个陷阱。

scripts.text: You're just as busy, eh? No worries. I have other adventurers helping me. Please tell Chief Kesler everything's good in my sector.
scripts.translation: 你也很忙啊？没关系，我还有其他冒险者帮忙。请告诉凯斯勒队长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: Wow, did you already disarm all the traps?
I have a more pressing matter at hand.
Thank you. I feel much better, knowing there are fewer traps around me. Please tell Chief Kesler that everything's well in my sector.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。附近陷阱少了，我心里也踏实些。请告诉凯斯勒队长，我负责的区域一切正常。

scripts.text: I'm already on the verge of a breakdown. You don't have to push.
scripts.translation: 我已经快崩溃了，别再给我压力了。

scripts.text: You haven't finished disarming 10 traps. I can see one in front of me. Why don't you start with that?
scripts.translation: 你还没拆完10个陷阱。我面前就有一个，何不从那个开始？

scripts.text: Oh no, haven't you seen any trap at all?
scripts.translation: 糟了，你一个陷阱都没看到吗？

scripts.text: Look for ??? written on the ground. That's the Doom Prayers' signature.
scripts.translation: 找找地面上写着“???”的地方，那是末日祈祷团的标记。

scripts.text: I can see one right in front of me. Ugh, my stomach...
scripts.translation: 我面前就有一个。唉，我胃又疼了...

scripts.text: I must be stressed out again. I feel my stomach tightening...
scripts.translation: 我一定又压力太大了，感觉胃都揪起来了...

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to continue. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续此任务。 -

scripts.text: *Chuckle* I know who you are, but I don't want to talk to you.
scripts.translation: *轻笑* 我知道你是谁，但我不想跟你说话。

scripts.text: *Chuckle* Be careful not to incur anyone's wrath.
scripts.translation: *轻笑* 小心别招来谁的怒火。

scripts.text: The same goes for Juperos. If the scientific knowledge of this place passed down to Schwarzwald, it could have been much more powerful.

scripts.text: Of course, that's based on my theory that the residents of this place were also Schwarzwaldians.
